title: Quality of Life Recipes
description: Datapack which adds common quality-of-life recipes which were traditionally included in modpacks through mods and tweaks. But now you can get them just through data!
body:
Datapack which adds common quality-of-life recipes which were traditionally included in modpacks through mods and tweaks. But now you can get them just through data!

Recipes currently implemented:
- 3 gravel to 2 flint shapeless recipe
- 2 logs to 16 sticks shaped recipe
- 1 clay block to 4 clay balls shapeless recipe
